objectives.identify-exposure: Trace an export request across trust boundaries and identify assets, exposure and controls.
objectives.constrain-policy: Design narrow permissions and safe defaults for an export operation.
objectives.fail-without-disclosure: Choose independent enforcement layers and preserve confidentiality when a decision cannot be made.
objectives.place-enforcement: Separate authentication evidence, trust decisions, written policy and runtime enforcement.

sections.title: Map what the export service protects
Reduce the authority that can travel

practice.prompt: The cleanup worker only removes expired exports. Which grant would you give it?

choices.label: Cleanup of expired exports in its tenant.
choices.reason: This grant matches the task, target and scope. The worker does not need to create or download exports.

choices.label: Read and cleanup of all exports.
choices.reason: Reading the export body and operating in every tenant are outside the stated job.

choices.label: The export owner’s dashboard role.
choices.reason: A human dashboard role serves a different purpose and makes the worker harder to constrain and audit.

practice.prompt: A previously valid export link is opened while the current membership lookup is unavailable. This service requires a fresh membership decision. What do you expect?

choices.label: Stop the download and return the approved service error.
choices.reason: The service cannot establish a current allow decision. It can report unavailability without disclosing export data.

choices.label: Serve the file because the link was valid earlier.
choices.reason: The original decision does not satisfy the fresh membership rule.

choices.label: Return the policy exception to help the caller debug.
choices.reason: Internal traces expose implementation details. Keep diagnostic reasons in restricted logs.

sections.title: Turn the policy into a runtime decision

items.label: Dashboard to API
items.detail: Validate the caller and request. Treat the resource identifier as an input.

items.label: API decision
items.detail: Use trusted grants and the export’s stored tenant.

items.label: API to storage
items.detail: Use a tenant-scoped lookup or a narrowly authorized storage operation.

items.label: Return bytes
items.detail: Only after the requested export and current decision agree.

items.label: Start
items.detail: Create an export for the tenant where the user has a create grant.

items.label: Download
items.detail: Require a separate read grant and a matching stored tenant.

items.label: Expire
items.detail: Remove only expired exports in its assigned tenant.

items.label: Keep out of scope
items.detail: Reading contents, publishing links and working across tenants.

items.label: Contained
items.detail: The handler does not open the export stream. A generic failure goes to the client.
